items.label: About
items.description: Click any sticker that's a picture of me to open the About Me page.

items.label: Projects
items.description: Click any code or tech related sticker to open the Projects page.

items.label: Contact
items.description: Click the phone or laptop sticker to open the Contact page.

navigation.heading: Navigation
navigation.description: Once inside a page, you can navigate directly to the other pages from within — no need to close and reopen.

pinned.heading: Pinned to the top
pinned.description: These stickers sit at the top of the page at all times — use them to toggle the theme and sound whenever you like.

items.label: Light Mode
items.description: Click the sun or white tote bag to switch to dark mode. They'll swap to a moon and a black tote bag.

items.label: Dark Mode
items.description: Click the moon or black tote bag to switch back to light mode. They'll swap back to a sun and a white tote bag.

items.label: Sound
items.description: Click the cat with headphones to toggle click sounds on or off.
